subject: Security Review — PR #47 API Rate Limiter
body:
Hi Arjun,

Completed security review of PR #47 (feature/api-rate-limiting). Overall the implementation is solid but I have two blockers:

1. The rate limiter uses IP address only. In environments behind a load balancer or NAT, this will incorrectly throttle multiple legitimate users sharing the same egress IP. We should also check the X-Forwarded-For header and use a composite key.

2. There is no protection against distributed attacks using rotating IPs. Consider adding a token bucket per authenticated user ID in addition to IP-based limiting.

Non-blocking suggestions:
- Add a Retry-After header in the 429 response (industry standard)
- Log throttled requests to the security audit trail

See the API rate limiting documentation at docs/api-rate-limiting.md for the architecture context.

This review is required before NEX-231 can be closed.

Kenji
